description: This file defines the interface 'DatatableWriteService', which specifies methods for managing data tables, including registration, deregistration, creation, updating, and deletion of data table entries within the system.

classes.name: DatatableWriteService
classes.description: Interface defining service methods for data table management operations.

methods.name: registerDatatable
methods.description: Registers a data table using a JsonCommand, with security restrictions.

methods.name: registerDatatable
methods.description: Registers a data table with specified table names and entity subtype, secured via authority checks.

methods.name: registerDatatable
methods.description: Registers a data table with a JsonCommand and a permission table, secured via authority checks.

methods.name: deregisterDatatable
methods.description: Deregisters a data table by name, with security restrictions.

methods.name: createDatatable
methods.description: Creates a new data table using a JsonCommand, returns a CommandProcessingResult.

methods.name: updateDatatable
methods.description: Updates an existing data table identified by name with new data specified in JsonCommand.

methods.name: deleteDatatable
methods.description: Deletes a data table by name.

methods.name: createNewDatatableEntry
methods.description: Creates a new entry in the specified data table, either with a JsonCommand or raw JSON string.

methods.name: updateDatatableEntryOneToOne
methods.description: Updates a one-to-one entry in a data table.

methods.name: updateDatatableEntryOneToMany
methods.description: Updates a one-to-many data table entry.

methods.name: deleteDatatableEntries
methods.description: Deletes multiple entries from a data table.

methods.name: deleteDatatableEntry
methods.description: Deletes a specific entry from the data table.

methods.name: createPPIEntry
methods.description: Creates an entry related to PPI (assuming some process or data context) in a data table.
